author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up from author: thanks for reaching out, still checking portfolios; send a link to previous work if you have not already.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. Character art: gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; book is lighter fantasy but art should feel grounded and lifelike; open to different styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Starting with portraits, may expand if the style fits the series. Map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, stylistically open. Contact: share work/recommendations on the thread or DM. Author still replying to applicants.

author: colli.ns258
title: Urgently looking for original artwork
content: URGENTLY LOOKING FOR ARTIST. Need some original artwork done for a personal project. Looking for a creative person who can follow references but still add their own touch. Good communication is important. Budget: £70–£115. Beginners with decent samples can apply too. No explicit contact method beyond the Threads post.
